h1: Custom Embroidery Koozies for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom embroidery koozies for your brand. Durable, stitched logos on premium koozies. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Embroidery adds a tactile, premium feel to custom koozies that screen printing or pad printing can't match. The stitched thread creates a raised, textured logo that resists fading and peeling, making it ideal for corporate gifts, trade shows, or employee appreciation where the koozie will see repeated use. Choose from cotton or neoprene blanks that hold embroidery cleanly, and your logo stays sharp wash after wash.
heroAltText: Custom embroidery koozies with stitched logo in bulk for corporate gifts
